input.summary: Add a fallback-level performance warranty (90-day software conformance, 30-day services) with repair/replacement or refund remedies as a new Servicer representation in Section 6.1(a).
input.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement gives us no conformance warranty or warranty remedy for the Servicer's systems and servicing work, so we added the playbook fallback warranty (90 days for software, 30 days for services) with repair, replacement or refund. We can discuss the preferred 12-month software period if that is easier to align with the servicing systems.

ops.text: Performance Warranty. The Servicer warrants that, for 90 days after delivery, any software and receivables systems it provides or makes available to the Issuer under this Agreement will conform in all material respects to their documentation, and that, for 30 days after performance, its servicing and other services under this Agreement will conform to this Agreement and the Servicing Procedures. For a breach of this warranty, the Servicer will, at the Issuer's option, repair or replace the non-conforming software, system or services or refund the Servicing Fee paid for them.
